name: git-autosync
description: Puts a working tree into attached mode before the first prompt of every session, network-free. It reads the remote-tracking refs the companion git plugin fetches (it never fetches the superproject itself) and, only when the root repo is on a branch (detached HEAD is a no-op), fast-forwards that branch to the remote's default branch (main, falling back to master), then populates each top-level submodule one level deep, attaches it to a branch named after the superproject's branch instead of a detached HEAD, and fast-forwards it to the superproject's recorded gitlink. Fast-forward only: a diverged branch is left exactly as it is. It waits on the git plugin's fetch barrier so the attach reads fresh refs, injects one attached-mode summary line for the agent when the pass runs, does nothing outside a git repo or in a repo with no remote, never fails a session, and turns off when GIT_AUTOSYNC_DISABLE is non-empty. Keeps only the latest launch status per session under the OS temp dir, surfaced by a read-only launch-status skill, and bundles a read-only recap skill reporting branch/tracking-remote/PR state for the superproject and each top-level submodule.
